s: Jacob belongs to the LORD
q: I have called you by your name. You are mine.

s: Jacob is chosen people of the LORD (formed to declare his praise)
q: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.

s: Jacob is witnesses (of the LORD)
q: “You are my witnesses,” says the LORD

s: the LORD is Holy One of Israel
q: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior.

s: Jacob is weary of the LORD (has not called on him)
q: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.

s: Jacob has fate curse (LORD will make Jacob a curse)
q: I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”

s: Babylon is target of the LORD (he will bring them down for Israel's sake)
q: For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives

s: Chaldeans are inhabitants of Babylon (to be brought down as fugitives)
q: I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

s: wilderness animals honor the LORD (jackals and ostriches, because he gives water)
q: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me

s: sins of Israel burden the LORD (wearied him with iniquities)
q: but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.

s: Israel's dispersed children (sons and daughters) are called by the LORD (created for his glory)
q: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.

s: Israel's dispersed children (sons and daughters) are gathered by the LORD (from east, west, north, south and far away)
q: I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.

s: the LORD created Jacob (also called Israel)
q: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says

s: the LORD redeems Jacob
q: Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

s: the LORD is unique as God (no God before or after him)
q: Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

s: the LORD is only savior
q: I myself am the LORD. Besides me, there is no savior.

s: the LORD is Creator of Israel (also King)
q: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.

s: the LORD has attribute unhindered power (no one can deliver out of his hand)
q: There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

s: the LORD chooses servant
q: With my servant whom I have chosen

s: the LORD is a King of Israel
q: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, the LORD of Armies, says

s: the LORD frustrates diviners and wise men (makes their knowledge foolish)
q: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

s: the LORD calls shepherd Cyrus (performs all his pleasure)
q: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’

s: Jacob is a servant of the LORD
q: Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

s: Jacob has status chosen (also called Jeshurun)
q: and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

s: Jacob has status sins blotted out (redeemed)
q: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

s: Jacob has status not forgotten by the LORD
q: Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.

s: children of Israel is a servant of the LORD
q: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant.

s: children of Israel has role witnesses of the LORD
q: You are my witnesses.

s: Cyrus is a shepherd of the LORD
q: He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure

s: Jerusalem will be inhabited (decreed by the LORD)
q: who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’

s: the LORD is a Redeemer (of Israel)
q: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, the LORD of Armies, says

s: Jerusalem has part temple (in Jerusalem) (its foundation will be laid)
q: and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”

s: idol makers has status vain (their delights will not profit)
q: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit.

s: idol makers has status will be put to shame
q: They will fear. They will be put to shame together.

s: idol makers is a mere men (workmen)
q: and the workmen are mere men.

s: idolatry is a abomination
q: Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination?

s: idolatry has property unprofitable (image profitable for nothing)
q: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?

s: carpenter shapes tree (the carpenter's wood) (into the figure of a man)
q: He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house.

s: children of Israel (the barren woman's children) receives Spirit (the LORD's Spirit) (promised outpouring)
q: I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

s: the LORD has status first and last
q: I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

s: the LORD is a only God (no God besides him)
q: Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not.

s: the LORD is a Rock (the only Rock)
q: I don’t know any other Rock.”

s: the LORD formed Jacob (from the womb)
q: the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says

s: the LORD chooses children of Israel
q: Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

s: the LORD redeems Jacob
q: for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

s: the LORD makes creation (heavens, earth, deep) (alone stretches out the heavens and spreads out the earth)
q: I am the LORD, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;

s: the LORD anoints Cyrus (calls him his anointed)
q: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor

s: the LORD speaks righteousness (does not speak in secret)
q: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness.

s: the LORD has sworn by himself (every knee shall bow to him)
q: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow

s: Cyrus is called by the LORD (called by name though he has not known him)
q: I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.
